paragraphs.label: Effect and operation
paragraphs.text: A completed blank carrier can encode one authentic, completed operational spell/ritual of rank at most 1; it allows 1 lifetime legal cast start(s), always of that same payload, plus +1 relevant research. Record exact spell/version/rank/class placement and genuine source access. A trained Calligrapher uses INT, the real desk/kit, max(1, rank) active hours, that many sp and 0.01 lb per hour of actual encoding supplies, and DC 10 + rank Core task binary resolution. Failure consumes time/supplies; encoding earns no crafting XP or Forge Dwarf reduction. No overwrite, capacity multiplication or refill. SC-03 expressly adds one-cast temporary repertoire only for a reader with the actual class/list, level/rank, RP, component and other spell eligibility. Use the spell's own action/time, range, concentration and cadence; pay one script use and normal resources at cast commitment. Counterspell can stop that paid cast; ready/release creates no second cast. The readable open script must be handled or supported within 5 feet; spell hands/components remain mandatory. Copying words does not copy magical uses. The research bonus requires the actual relevant lead consultation under SC-05. SC-01–05 and SC-10 govern the full procedure. These research/navigation bonuses apply only to their genuinely relevant recorded subject and actual eligible information task. They do not improve attacks, saves, spell DCs, spellcasting, unrelated checks, manufacture or repair. The item's own authoring, copying or encoding, and creation of a new bonus-granting reference from that same item, receive no self-production bonus. Genuine relevant formula research remains separately eligible without guaranteeing discovery.

paragraphs.label: Before creation
paragraphs.text: Reserve 6 actual complete never-magically-altered bodies, one model/size per order, in an exclusive fixed order. All must be complete and positive-HP immediately before the completion roll, even if fewer outputs will result. Bodies are additional to the exact source batch components and working tools. Pre-roll lawful replacement keeps its ordered position; no post-roll acquisition, substitution or reordering. Transform the first resolved outputs; unused bodies remain actual mundane stock. Record material identity, condition, real storage, actual station capacity, preservation and safe handling; a quoted price supplies none of those facts.

paragraphs.label: Retention and failure
paragraphs.text: This recipe has no eligible catalyst-return occurrence. On Failed creation, for each eligible exact consumed non-catalyst input identity, recover at most one quarter of its fixed consumed-input quantity for this batch, capped by the eligible amount actually remaining from those same inputs, and rounded down once to that identity's legal source-unit precision. Do not take one quarter of the surviving remainder. Previously returned, forfeited or lost quantities and unrelated stock cannot fund this recovery. For each exact eligible identity in this batch, use `recovered_i = u_i × floor(min(Q_i / 4, R_i) / u_i)`. Q_i is its fixed consumed-input quantity; R_i is the eligible amount surviving from those same inputs; u_i is its legal source-unit precision. Group only genuinely identical eligible inputs within this same batch while retaining every physical occurrence. Catalysts and unrelated batches do not enter that recovery group. The per-occurrence record identifies only expressly divisible bulk; otherwise floor to indivisible units. No quarter tool/lens/core, money conversion, duplicate catalyst, or second salvage pass over waste. Mishap/abandonment returns no consumed inputs. Retained working tools and unused complete bodies survive only as they actually exist. Returned material retains real age, vessels and history; a retained catalyst is not also inside the finished item.

These research/navigation bonuses apply only to their genuinely relevant recorded subject and actual eligible information task. They do not improve attacks, saves, spell DCs, spellcasting, unrelated checks, manufacture or repair. The item's own authoring, copying or encoding, and creation of a new bonus-granting reference from that same item, receive no self-production bonus. Genuine relevant formula research remains separately eligible without guaranteeing discovery.

The supplied governing files mention translation progress but **do not supply a complete Language Insight currency/spend procedure**. Complete that specific gap here; do not label these numbers as recovered rules or invent an entire language-learning system.

**NEW Language Insight ledger:** points are recorded per researcher and one identified target language, maximum **six unspent points per language**. After **one active hour** of genuine study of a legible, authenticated, useful parallel text into a language that researcher understands,498/500 may grant their one point;674 grants **three** toward its one preregistered actual ancient language. The same underlying evidence/correspondences grant their points **once per researcher**, shared across original/copies, other physical editions and magically remade books using the same content. The reader/underlying evidence ID, not the current holder ID, is the anti-repeat key. Different readers can learn from the same real work; points cannot be transferred or sold as another character's comprehension. Saturation gives no substitute reward or later deferred excess.

**NEW finite use:** spend **three Insight for that language** and **eight active hours** of actual study with the evidence to translate one preregistered passage of at most **250 words** into a language the researcher knows. The passage must genuinely exist, be accessible/legible, and be covered by the evidence's actual vocabulary/correspondence; the Director must possess or establish the real source meaning. It grants that passage's supported literal translation, not general spoken fluency, hidden truths, deciphering a separate cipher or permission to learn a spell. Missing or unsupported meaning leaves the project unqualified before spending; it is not solved by a fabricated Insight result. This is a new specific translation procedure, not a reset of ordinary research progress or automatic completion of an unrelated project. The eight hours are work, not rest or Forge Dwarf creation. Use this specific Insight translation route or an independently authorized ordinary Translate project; the same active hours do not also award a second project's progress, an Insight gain or recipe XP.

674's **+3 cross-disciplinary research** applies only to genuine research requiring at least two of its printed five disciplines, with one declared lead check using the relevant actual skill and the normal assistance/proficiency rules. An eight-hour investigation at **NEW DC20** may examine an actually recorded ordinary cross-disciplinary correspondence: Core success reveals only the supported relation, failure no reliable new relation, critical no invented lore. RC-01.title: Six families, one physical rune rather than a free site
RC-01.text:
**Affected:396–432,664–667. NEW bodies:** Binding, Explosive, Healing, Warding and generic Rune families use one RC-plate each;667 uses its larger RC-seal. Generic Rune family entries are **warding profiles**, not an unspecified fifth spell family. No direct inscription into a wearer, floor, entire door or armor is an alternate free body. A physical plate may be placed or strapped to that surface with actual support, becoming a separately tracked item. Parent and plate cannot both count the plate's material.

Placing a carried plate within5ft on stable support and arming it takes **one Action, one free hand**; an already placed plate can be armed with that Action. Its **one5ft trigger square** is declared at arming, containing the plate, unobstructed and currently unoccupied by an eligible entrant. Arming completes at the beginning of the armer's next regular turn, or after six elapsed seconds outside initiative. No placement under an occupying creature produces immediate entry. Disarming one's accessible plate uses an Action; removing it uses the actual item interaction afterward. A ward-bearing plate instead follows RC-07;667 follows RC-10.

A moved, rotated off its declared working face, wholly covered/closed-in-container, Broken, incomplete or suppressed triggered plate cannot produce a new trigger. Movement invalidates its placed trigger geometry and disarms it; merely uncovering/repairing/unsuppressing does not rearm. Existing Binding effects require the original unmoved eligible plate and end if it is moved, Broken, covered or suppressed. Already resolved damage/healing is unchanged. A door used as support opens/moves its plate and therefore disarms it; the rune does not turn the whole doorway into an untracked remote site.

RC-02.title: Entry, touch, occupancy and detection
RC-02.text:
**NEW event definition:** entry is one actual crossing from outside into the declared square/volume by walking, forced movement, falling or teleport arrival. Remaining inside, starting a turn there, an extra turn or retelling the same movement is not entry. A sufficiently large creature entering by any occupied portion is one entrant, not one per square/body part. Actual line of effect and contact geometry apply. Noncreature objects do not trigger creature-entry clauses.

Binding/Explosive trigger on the first eligible creature, including the setter or an ally; no unseen friend-or-foe filter. Order simultaneous entrants by the encounter's preregistered stable resolution order, not post-roll player choice. Healing instead requires its designated eligible ally and uses RC-06. The base runes are visible inscriptions when exposed; no Stealth/invisibility from names. A deliberate concealed installation needs actual cover and a legitimate ordinary concealment procedure, not an automatic hidden DC.

**NEW inspection/disarm:** one active minute within5ft with safe access permits INT/Arcana or INT/Runecarver's-tools examination against the original recipe creation DC, Core task collapsed to binary, to learn this actual rune's operating type/trigger, not donor lore. Failure grants no missing information or repeat on unchanged evidence. A trained Runecarver with actual tools may spend one minute to disarm an unknown accessible rune at that DC; failure leaves it armed and triggers one discharge only if the worker actually supplies an eligible entry/touch event declared in the work plan. No invented remote explosion from a failed identification. Destroying or safely covering the plate remains an actual physical alternative. SC-01.title: Nine body families; authentic content, then one encoded payload
SC-01.text:
**Affected:471–506,672–675. NEW body/content completion.** Tome/Book/Codex/Lexicon use SC-book; Text/Formula SC-text; Map/Diagram SC-sheet; Scroll SC-scroll. Those are nine distinct source-family bindings, not nine free spellbooks. A source Codex remains that recipe identity even when it shares an ordinary body model. The22 script outputs are manufactured as **blank, loadable magical carriers**, with one payload slot and their original maximum rank/use capacity. A seller must distinguish blank from genuinely loaded. Before encoding, record one actual complete operational spell/ritual, its precise source ID/version, class/school placement, class-specific rank and authentic readable text. A qualified source supplier must actually know/have legitimate access to that text; a title, summary, photograph-shaped ID or unfinished spell record is insufficient. SC-03.title: Exact casting gate; named narrow repertoire addition
SC-03.text:
**NEW `script-temporary-repertoire` rule:** an authentic loaded operational script may supply its **one stored spell as a temporary repertoire/prepared choice for that activation only**. This is an explicit narrow addition to `M/SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md`'s ordinary actual-repertoire requirement, not a claim that owning a source text already granted that exception. It teaches nothing permanently, expands no known/prepared capacity after activation, and applies to none of the18 references. All other class gates remain unchanged.

The activating caster must possess the actual stored class/school placement, that class's minimum level/rank access, sufficient current RP/other actual casting resource, legal components/actions/targets and the ability to read/understand the encoded text. The stored placement is fixed at encoding; a different class's lower rank cannot be substituted mid-use. Its class-specific rank must be within the carrier cap. A noncaster or ineligible class cannot activate it. No generic UMD roll, level check, accidental backlash or noncaster RP pool is added. Unfinished ordinary spells and unranked/uncompleted rituals cannot be loaded by treating absent rank/effect fields as zero.

Use the actual spell's casting time, Action/BA/Reaction trigger, range, components, concentration, target count, attack/DC and interruption procedure. The script must be open and readable in hand or on actual support within5ft throughout required reading; a stowed/closed/melded script is inaccessible. Reading creates no free object retrieval or extra hands; class F permission still needs its own actual focus and normal S/F hand rules. No extra universal verbal component is invented beyond the actual spell.

At legal cast start spend **one script use plus all normal RP/material/class costs**. The script substitutes only the narrow repertoire/prepared gate, not RP, costly components, Dissonance surcharge, concentration or source per-rest limits. Apply that caster's actual spell attack/DC, Dissonance and Refrain once, using the stored spell's real name; switching physical books does not reset same-name cadence. A ritual requires its actual ritual-use permission and full duration/cost rules. No generic upcasting: only a separately authorized version that was actually encoded and within the cap. Readied activation uses the existing one-cast chronology; release is not a second script use/cast. An actual Counterspell can counter this spell; a countered cast refunds no script use or other cost.

Thus insufficient RP, wrong class, missing components, inaccessible text or no legal trigger blocks commitment without expenditure. A legally committed later failure spends the use. This is a complete container/use procedure; the actual operational payload is a bounded per-load execution dependency, not another advanced-recipe source conference.

SC-04.title: Copies, shared readers and identity
SC-04.text:

Script uses and map rerolls remain per physical item, not reader. Once the last script use is spent, rewriting that pattern is not replenishment. The item's own authoring, copying or encoding, and creation of a new bonus-granting reference from that same item, receive no self-production bonus. Genuine relevant formula research remains separately eligible without guaranteeing discovery.

SC-06.title: Eleven per-expedition rerolls
SC-06.text:
**Affected:472,477–479,485,493,494,497,503,506,673.** KEEP the printed per-expedition frequency; **NEW identity binding:** use the actual formally registered Expedition charter/mission ID from the campaign loop, continuing through outward travel, staged camps, extraction and its formal Haven resolution. A Watch, brief Haven stop, new holder, split party, new route or entering initiative is not a new expedition. A new ID requires the prior expedition's actual terminal disposition and a genuinely launched next charter/objective/reserve under the governing loop, not paperwork created solely to reset an item. For non-expedition work the map has its numerical relevant bonus but no fabricated expedition reroll budget.

One physical map/diagram has one shared reroll for that expedition, even if ten owners use it. On an actual failed related qualifying task, after failure is known but **before its consequences are committed**, the lead may spend that item's unspent reroll. Reroll the whole original die-selection operation with its original modifiers, DC and advantage/disadvantage context; use the new result and its native natural-die rule even if worse. It is not a new task, extra elapsed research, another RP payment or another set of outcomes. At most one Scribing item reroll is applied to one check; another map cannot repeatedly reroll it. Other independently reviewed class rerolls retain their own specific arbitration, not an invented universal ban/permission. A completed failed outcome cannot be rewound afterward.

SC-07.title: Language comprehension, research party and languages:0
SC-07.text:
KEEP **languages:0 on476,486,672**: no language benefit, not an absent field. **498 and500** retain languages:1/one Language Insight only with an actual usable parallel translation. Understanding a subject does not imply reading its language; a genuinely qualified translator's actual work may make content accessible under the research procedure, without adding their item bonus to the lead or copying magic.

Multiple references offer the strongest individually eligible task-family bonus once, not one bonus per author, reader, book, skill proficiency or language. Assistants supply only the task's own real assistant contribution and full required work, never extra PB or extra map/script use pools. No immediate fluency, skill proficiency or additional language follows from a title, possession or zero/positive metadata alone. Pending Linguist/Polyglot/Runic Scholar/Spell Scribe benefits remain pending.
SC-07.verdictHeading: ## SC-07 — Language comprehension, research party and languages:0

SC-08.title: NEW bounded Language Insight completion and recipe674
SC-08.text:
The supplied governing files mention translation progress but **do not supply a complete Language Insight currency/spend procedure**. Complete that specific gap here; do not label these numbers as recovered rules or invent an entire language-learning system.

**NEW Language Insight ledger:** points are recorded per researcher and one identified target language, maximum **six unspent points per language**. After **one active hour** of genuine study of a legible, authenticated, useful parallel text into a language that researcher understands,498/500 may grant their one point;674 grants **three** toward its one preregistered actual ancient language. The same underlying evidence/correspondences grant their points **once per researcher**, shared across original/copies, other physical editions and magically remade books using the same content. The reader/underlying evidence ID, not the current holder ID, is the anti-repeat key. Different readers can learn from the same real work; points cannot be transferred or sold as another character's comprehension. Saturation gives no substitute reward or later deferred excess.

**NEW finite use:** spend **three Insight for that language** and **eight active hours** of actual study with the evidence to translate one preregistered passage of at most **250 words** into a language the researcher knows. The passage must genuinely exist, be accessible/legible, and be covered by the evidence's actual vocabulary/correspondence; the Director must possess or establish the real source meaning. It grants that passage's supported literal translation, not general spoken fluency, hidden truths, deciphering a separate cipher or permission to learn a spell. Missing or unsupported meaning leaves the project unqualified before spending; it is not solved by a fabricated Insight result. This is a new specific translation procedure, not a reset of ordinary research progress or automatic completion of an unrelated project. The eight hours are work, not rest or Forge Dwarf creation. Use this specific Insight translation route or an independently authorized ordinary Translate project; the same active hours do not also award a second project's progress, an Insight gain or recipe XP.

674's **+3 cross-disciplinary research** applies only to genuine research requiring at least two of its printed five disciplines, with one declared lead check using the relevant actual skill and the normal assistance/proficiency rules. An eight-hour investigation at **NEW DC20** may examine an actually recorded ordinary cross-disciplinary correspondence: Core success reveals only the supported relation, failure no reliable new relation, critical no invented lore. Another attempt needs new evidence/method. It neither creates secret content nor operates its separate latent Matrix metadata. Its three points are not three new languages, per-day points or a spellcasting bonus.

This completes usable Insight behavior without approving the pending language feats. Additional ordinary fluency courses remain outside the recipe's promise, not a blocker to authoring674.
SC-08.verdictHeading: ## SC-08 — NEW bounded Language Insight completion and recipe674

SC-09.title: Custom675: finite willing bargain and mark
SC-09.text:
KEEP one bargain, willing creatures, **6d10 psychic** breach and **30-day mark**; no spell/save/DC/charge field is silently added to the source. **NEW operating limits:** one lifetime bargain in this physical Codex, **two to six capable willing signatories**, at most **three objective clauses**, one specified start and deadline no later than **30 elapsed days** after final signature. All parties must be present within5ft, personally comprehend the entire text and consequences, and freely assent without compulsion, coercion, deception about the terms or inability to consent. Spend **ten active minutes** of actual reading/signing with the complete accessible unsuppressed Codex. Only the final legal signature commits its one bargain. A corpse, ordinary low-INT automaton, name without an actual signer, proxy or forged signature cannot consent.

Before commitment fix the exact parties, permitted actions/omissions, observability/evidence, deadline, impossibility exceptions and resolution order. Ambiguous, internally contradictory, inherently impossible, secretly changing or belief/emotion-detection clauses are not eligible. The codex is not an oracle, truth spell, ownership transfer, universal legal court or soul contract. Subsequent unavoidable impossibility not caused by a party's voluntary breach excuses that party's impossible performance; disputed facts require actual Director adjudication of the preregistered objective terms, not an unsupported caller boolean. Ordinary legal effects and fictional enforceability remain separate from this one agreed magical consequence.

**NEW enforcement range:** a breach can trigger only while the original operative Codex and that actual signatory are within one mile in the same established campaign world, with their actual locations recorded. The effect does not require visual contact, but it supplies no detection, evidence gathering or planar link; the pre-agreed objective facts still require genuine adjudication. Outside that scope there is no trigger or queued later punishment for that past event. A later different proven breach within scope may spend an otherwise unused entitlement. An already applied mark retains its own30-day deadline outside the range. Moving the Codex does not restart covenant or mark clocks.

**First proven voluntary breach by each signatory while the covenant is active and within that enforcement scope** spends that signatory's one breach entitlement, inflicts6d10 psychic through actual defenses as one nonspell magical damage event, and applies the mark even if damage is fully prevented. No save is added to a willingly accepted consequence. Repeated breaches, multiple clauses, repairs and extra turns cannot deal it again to that signer. At most six such events per Codex. The mark is a visible magical identifying sigil on one agreed physically possible patch of the violator's actual body or shell, selected at signing, not on a removable carried identification plate. Clothing can conceal it, but discarding clothing does not remove it. A later permitted form change preserves that same creature's mark and remaining deadline without granting any remote identification or tracking power. It supplies no tracking, compelled behavior, damage pulse, penalties, forced allegiance or extra target vulnerability. It is not automatically the generic Marked condition or a curse by name.

The mark expires30 elapsed days after its actual application. Earlier consensual release requires the original functional Codex, all surviving competent signatories' informed assent and ten active minutes; it ends future enforcement and its still-active marks, never refunds use or damage. An independently reviewed effect explicitly able to remove this kind of nonspell magical mark may apply within its real scope; no invented spell rank is assigned for a rank-limited dispel. Otherwise use release/expiry, not an unknown-tier automatic cure.

Enforcement follows only events in the same established campaign world/identity history; this rule creates no planar reach, cross-world tracking or cosmological transport. Suppression, unreadable/incomplete primary pages or Broken state suspends **future** enforcement while duration runs. Missed breaches are not queued or replayed on repair. Irrecoverable destruction ends future enforcement; marks already applied retain their own duration/removal. Fulfillment/deadline ends future enforcement, not already applied marks. A copy cannot enforce another covenant or restore a spent one.

**NEW ordinary-annotation reader gate:** a researcher of character level11 or higher with actual proficiency in at least three of Arcana/History/Religion/Nature/Engineering may spend one active hour studying675 to perceive its one actually provided ordinary hidden annotation. This is one bounded local reading, not automatically the Matrix clue in its separately preserved metadata. With no actual authorized annotation content, reveal no invented message. The latent Matrix object and literal wording remain preserved and nonoperative pending their own later gate.
SC-09.verdictHeading: ## SC-09 — Custom675: finite willing bargain and mark

SC-10.title: Exact outliers and body/input separation
SC-10.text: **672 Eldritch-Ichor Ink Formula** is the source's reference Text/Formula profile, research+1, languages0, not an ink-production recipe. It retains its actual two hours, false field flag and source discovery; no secret ink quantity, spell, free formula or consumed fuel is authored. **673 Void-Eye Survey Diagram** uses one SC-sheet with its+2/reroll profile and consumes its actual **673[3] Tier5 Protective case,200gp/1lb**, separately from that sheet, retained writing kit and actual storage. Its title does not create vision through walls, an unprinted sensor or refund its consumed case. All original fields, bodies and source gates remain as registered.
SC-10.verdictHeading: ## SC-10 — Exact outliers and body/input separation

TI-04.title: Control, binding, orders and finite active count
TI-04.text:
**NEW crafted control protocol:** a capable consenting user with INT6+ and actual access to the nonhostile unbound chassis may spend ten active minutes with Tinker's tools to register one controller and one simple task; no proficiency is granted or required merely to use a known functioning control interface. An already bound item requires its existing controller's actual release or a separately completed lawful control procedure. Ownership alone does not hack hostile/unknown/locked machinery. Transfer preserves service/HP/use histories and consumes the same ten minutes; no combat rebind for another action.

A controller may have **three active crafted automata** among the18 ordinary profiles, plus at most **one active686 coordinator** under its own exception. Additional owned machines must be deactivated, carried/stored with their real mass, or actually transferred to a capable different controller. They do not consume class Anacite/deployable slots and cannot become extra class-slot capacity. Class limits remain separately applicable, and **one shared command and one offensive companion/device allowance per owner per numbered round** applies across both systems. Deactivation/rebinding does not refund a round's spent allowance.

Command: Bonus Action on the controller's regular turn, target within60ft with actual visible/audible control communication and lawful access. Choose that machine's one eligible move plus one basic attack or one programmed task action. It executes after the controller's whole turn in the existing attached phase; no independent initiative turn, Reaction or recharge. Uncommanded active machines may move defensively and Dodge only; they do not obey a standing kill/harvest/attack order. Failed execution consumes the committed command/offense allowance; later controller incapacity alone does not cancel it, but source ending, suppression, exhausted power or an illegal target can prevent execution.

Outside initiative a programmed task must be a deterministic physically possible sequence using its actual appendages: carry one identified supported item along an already traversable specified route, operate one known ordinary lever, or sort a finite identified set by a visible physical property. No unseen search/identification, discretionary hostile targeting, professional task or indefinite resource production. Reprogramming takes ten real active minutes and does not refresh its service block. An hour of work pays TI-05's six blocks, not six free encounters. Loss of communication permits only its already legal finite noncombat sequence; no new target choice or attack. A controller may give one wholly noncombat task start with an Action; the same capacities and actual power limits apply.
TI-04.verdictHeading: ## TI-04 — Control, binding, orders and finite active count

TI-05.title: Source N encounters and NEW out-of-combat accounting
TI-05.text:
For each18 ordinary automaton, `serviceRemaining` starts at its printed N. First actual operation in a genuine encounter spends one unit, covering only that encounter and at most **ten elapsed minutes**. If the encounter genuinely exceeds ten minutes, another unit funds the next block without declaring a new encounter or refreshing class uses. Leaving/reentering that same encounter inside its paid block does not spend or grant another unit; starting a distinct genuine encounter does spend another. No benefit from attacking allies, helpless captives or harmless animals to manufacture encounter boundaries.

Outside encounters, first operation opens one **ten-elapsed-minute** block and spends one unit. A pause/shutdown/suppression does not refund or extend that block. Entering a genuine encounter closes an earlier noncombat block and spends a new encounter unit. Ordinary idleness before a block starts spends nothing and grants no active behavior. At zero with no remaining paid block, the creature is inert and grants no movement/Dodge/task/attack until real service; a balance of zero during a paid block does not shorten that legitimately paid block. Blocks remain tied to physical identity across transfer, rest, damage, repair and initiative changes.

These are NEW finite accounting completions of the printed encounter service life, not independent charge attacks within the paid encounter. An attack still requires its own normal command/offense allowance every round. Short/long rest, dawn, Field Repair, Snap Rebuild and returning from meld restore no service unit.686 has its distinct winding profile; it does not inherit N from a similarly named automaton.

TI-08.title: Custom686, three-target coordination without hostile command
TI-08.text:
KEEP **Small,AC18,HP80,three targets,120ft and the literal Silent Ones/Heartcell prohibition**. NEW body TI-drone has walk25ft, STR12,DEX10,CON12,INT6,WIS10,CHA1, ordinary sight/hearing, passivePerception10, no flight/telepathy/attack or Anacite stats. Its relative intelligence is a limited protocol processor, not an assertion about a soul or sentience. It can convey observed ordinary status, not hidden state or remote inventories.

**NEW power:** one minute of actual manual winding with both hands powers at most one elapsed hour; capped at one hour remaining. Rewinding requires stopping the drone and actual access, never banks hours. Suppression/pause does not stop that elapsed deadline. This is its own winding clock, not a source charges field, dawn recharge or restoration. A complete positive-HP chassis is required. Power alone authorizes no command or offense.

Register its capable controller under TI-04. During ten active minutes, link at most three actual consenting/authorized existing Constructs or dungeon mechanisms, each with an actual protocol, current controller/owner permission, physically compatible interface and lawful action profile. No hostile control check is supplied; unknown/hostile/forbidden links fail admission rather than being overcome by a high roll. Replace a link only after explicit release and the same real setup. A fourth cannot act by briefly joining an oversized list. Silent Ones and Heartcell systems are never eligible under this item, even with a purported permission flag; preserve those literal identifiers without deciding their taxonomy.

The controller may use their one normal Bonus Action command to send a directly coordinated instruction through686 to a linked target **within120ft of the drone with line of effect**. Controller-to-drone communication must itself satisfy TI-04's60ft actual channel. One hop only. Up to three linked targets may receive status/task selection information, but **only one commanded action** executes through that owner's shared allowance; the others gain no action, attack or offensive movement. Another independently controlling creature must pay its own actual commands/actions for its own target. Class drones retain their class-specific command range/eligibility and no new class module/cap from the relay.686's range supplies no exception to a target mechanism's own restricted control source.

Loss of link/range/power before execution fails that command without refund; restored contact grants only later ordinary commands. No shared save/DC improvement, RP transfer, battlefield turn, automatic turret shot, forced consent or permission to operate a mechanism whose actual procedure remains unknown is supplied.
TI-08.verdictHeading: ## TI-08 — Custom686, three-target coordination without hostile command

TD-01.title: Identity and each class benefit
TD-01.text:
KEEP automatic Anacite ownership, its actual AC/HP/flight/bolt/Shock profile and its specific reconstruction/module routes. The 18 TI automata and686 are separate purchased/crafted Constructs; the other24 TI outputs are mechanical objects. None is an Anacite, class bomb, class turret, class Net Trap or class temporary deployable solely by a shared word. The complete 48-card eligibility register below identifies every card's reach. General device effects are expressly admitted only through the gates below; no Tinker level or selected card is awarded by ownership.

For general class-device effects, **NEW target binding** is a complete actual TI mechanical body or surviving recoverable original TI wreck, with the required current state. It does not automatically include EN weapons, Rune tablets, Scribing books, gathering implements or every magical item. Jury-rig's separate printed weapon target may admit an actual EN weapon on its own terms; that does not make it a Tinker device. Consumed process lenses, power cells and input Control mechanisms are not additional finished target devices.
TD-01.verdictHeading: ## TD-01 — Identity and each class benefit

TD-08.title: Protected Dissonance routing
TD-08.text:
KEEP once per short rest, Bonus Action, up to two **current** Dissonance, one of that Tinker's actual active devices within30ft. Explicitly admit TI devices only when currently genuinely active: an armed charged trap; a powered automaton/686 in its paid/wound operating interval; a utility actually participating in a live eligible task; or an aligned ram in its live legal cycle. Merely carrying a cheap unused tool is not an active device. This is an eligibility definition, not a new Dissonance/RP conversion rate.

Routing disables movement, attack, aura, trigger and other active use while its duration/service clock continues. No RP appears and Refrain does not reset. Clear that specific disable through actual Field Repair where qualified, or the engine's ten active minutes/1RP/Tinker's tools route, or **the routing Tinker's next completed genuine short rest**. A buyer's unrelated rest does not clear another user's routed state. Normal HP restoration may clear it only after that actual repair completes; paying a quote or renaming a device does not. None refills uses. Transfer retains disable origin, expiry, resource record and current body. One short-rest allowance remains one regardless of the number or price of owned machines.
